checks.label: Which physics the motion happens in

detail.medium_source: standard reference values for pure water at 20 C and 1 atm (CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, fluid properties tables)
detail.medium_caveat: Pure water at 20 C. Culture medium, pond water, mucus, biofilm and cytoplasm are all more viscous, some by orders of magnitude, and a Reynolds number computed with this value is an UPPER bound on the real one for a swimmer in any of them.
detail.boundaries: There is no sharp boundary. Re = 1 is the conventional marker for where viscous forces dominate inertial ones and Re ~ 1000 for where inertia dominates; between them both matter and neither limit applies. The scallop theorem is a statement about the STOKES limit (Re -> 0), and applying it at Re = 0.9 rather than Re = 0.001 is a judgement, so the check reports the number and says how far into the limit the design actually is.

checks.reading: Re runs from 1.99e-5 to 9.96e-5 across the stated ranges: creeping (viscous forces dominate) at one end, creeping (viscous forces dominate) at the other.

checks.label: Purcell scallop theorem
checks.limiting_factor: the stroke is time-reversible (declared reciprocal) and Re <= 9.96e-5 everywhere in the stated ranges. In the Stokes limit the displacement over a cycle depends on the PATH through configuration space and not on the rate, so a path that retraces itself returns the body exactly where it started. Net displacement per cycle is zero, at any beat frequency.

detail.gait: a single hinged paddle that opens and closes, driven faster on the power stroke than on the recovery stroke
detail.gait_source: DESIGN INPUT: the first design proposed for this organism
detail.source: Purcell EM 1977, Life at low Reynolds number, Am J Phys 45(1):3-11
detail.what_would_fix_it: break the time-reversal symmetry: a rotating helix, a travelling wave along a flagellum, or a cilium whose recovery stroke follows a different path from its power stroke. Two or more degrees of freedom moved out of phase trace a loop, and a loop encloses area, and enclosed area is displacement.

what_this_layer_cannot_say: whether the organism can generate the forces its gait requires: there is no muscle model and no actuator model
whether it can pay for the motion: no metabolic rate, no cost of transport, no energy budget
whether it can control the motion or stay the right way up: no stability model

result.scope: How a design moves, as distinct from what it is made of. One theorem (the scallop theorem, which can declare a design impossible), arithmetic over declared quantities, and empirical regime indicators that are reported and never fail anything. It models no muscle, no metabolism, no control and no energy budget: a design this layer does not contradict has not been shown to move, only shown not to be self-contradictory in the ways this layer can see.
